articles.summary: PLANO, Texas (Oct. 2, 2026) –The 2027 Toyota Corolla Cross blends practical utility, surprising capability, and a stylish design that hits a sweet spot for everyday living. Its choice of gas or hybrid powertrains, and available front- or all-wheel drive (FWD or AWD), make it ready for the daily commute and weekend adventures alike.
